name: Deep Elem Mine
summary: Deep Elem Mine lies in central Silverpine Forest, its tunnels claimed by worgen. Once an active mine, it fell when Archmage Arugal's magic swept through the region and transformed its miners.

sections.title: A Den of Beasts
sections.body: Deep Elem Mine once supplied the living people of Lordaeron with ore. When Archmage Arugal unleashed his lupine curse across Silverpine Forest, it spread through the tunnels. The laborers succumbed and became vicious worgen, abandoning their pickaxes to claim the cavern as a lair.

sections.title: Grimson and Forsaken Ambition
sections.body: Grimson the Pale commands the pack inside the mine. Once its foreman, he kept his cunning through the transformation. The Forsaken at the Sepulcher seek to reclaim the tunnels and their ore. On orders backed by Dreadlord Varimathras, Forsaken agents mean to sever Grimson's head and purge the beasts so the Horde can secure the mine's wealth.

faq.q: What is inside Deep Elem Mine?
aliases: who lives in deep elem mine
faq.answer: Hostile worgen afflicted by Archmage Arugal's magic fill the mine. Their pack is led by Grimson the Pale, once the human foreman, who now rules deep in the tunnels.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken want Deep Elem Mine cleared?
faq.answer: The Forsaken want the mine's mineral wealth for their war efforts in Lordaeron. Dalar Dawnweaver and the Sepulcher's leaders intend to claim its resources in the name of Dreadlord Varimathras once the worgen are eradicated.

Grimson the Pale was the mortal foreman of Deep Elem Mine. Arugal's feral curse transformed the workers, and Grimson became a cunning worgen alpha who kept enough intellect to command the pack in the mine.

faq.q: How did the worgen get into the mine?
aliases: why are there worgen in the mine
faq.answer: The worgen began as the mine's own laborers. Archmage Arugal's curse spread across Silverpine Forest and transformed them where they worked.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, securing the mine brings economic gain and answers the Sepulcher's order to break Arugal's grip on central Silverpine.
The feral pack makes mining dangerous, but Deep Elem Mine holds one of Silverpine's richest underground mineral deposits.
